A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ProMoS research and contain complete main text and Appendices A–E. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the equations, figures, tables and appendices.

before.justification: v1 reports original graph anomaly detection experiments, including benchmark results in Tables 2–3, ablations, efficiency measurements and supplementary experiments in Appendices C and E.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, efficiency measurements and supplementary experiments reported in v1.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same frozen teacher, adapter, shared and personalized students, prototype distillation, discrepancy-aware objectives and anomaly scoring procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 15 graphs, with four default training graphs and eleven test graphs. The alternative pretraining configuration and few-shot comparison scenarios in Appendix E are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 2–3, the few-shot comparisons in Table 9 and the efficiency experiments. SpaceGNN was cited but not evaluated in v1; removing its citation does not remove an experimental baseline.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix D retain identical splits, anomaly injection procedures, 64-dimensional feature projection, AUROC/AUPRC metrics and training configurations. Appendix E.1 retains the same 10-shot protocol for ARC and AnomalyGFM.

E4.justification: The component ablations, teacher-backbone tests, optimization comparisons and efficiency analyses are unchanged. Appendix E retains identical pretraining comparisons, visualizations, student activation and diversity analyses, and hyperparameter sensitivity studies.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard deviations over five runs with different random seeds. The uncertainty reporting in the main experiments and appendices is unchanged.

E6.justification: All reported numerical and qualitative experimental results are unchanged, including Tables 2–6 and 9–12 and Figures 2–8. For example, ProMoS's Cora AUROC remains 84.56 ± 0.16 in Table 2.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and derivations are unchanged. Appendix A retains Theorem A.1, its mean-alignment and equicorrelation assumptions, and its proof; Appendix C retains the same complexity analysis.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about the first unsupervised generalist GAD framework, prototype-based knowledge transfer, zero-shot generalization and efficiency. No contribution is added, removed or substantively reframed.

C2.justification: Interpretations of normality transfer, branch complementarity, sparse routing and sensitivity results are unchanged. The Impact Statement retains the same cautions about distribution mismatch, false alarms and human oversight despite its shifted position.

D1.justification: Appendix D.2 retains identical hardware, software, teacher-pretraining instructions, prototype initialization and hyperparameter settings. The source-code and dataset access information on page 1 is unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 removes Dong et al. (2025), SpaceGNN, from the supervised GAD discussion in Section 2 and deletes its bibliography entry. This is a limited citation removal; the surrounding research positioning is unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 expands the funding acknowledgements and introduces the typo 'tDriven' in place of 'Driven' at the start of the abstract. Apart from citation removal and version/date text, the prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Local text reflow occurs on pages 1, 2 and 9. Expanded acknowledgements shift the Impact Statement and references on page 9. All figures and tables retain their content and design, and the remaining pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding attribution, removes one background citation and introduces a small abstract typo. These localized changes leave the method, theoretical and empirical support, reproducibility information and appendices unchanged, producing no meaningful net difference in overall quality.
